interview.common.intro: I will ask eight short questions. Anything already set in factory.toml or your profile is skipped.
interview.common.what.q: What do you want to make?
interview.common.what.hint: One line is enough. The format catalogue comes next.
interview.common.what.example: A short post about why I stopped using three tools at once.
interview.common.what.skip: Taken from the format you chose: {value}
interview.common.where.q: Where should it go? Pick one or more platforms.
interview.common.where.hint: threads, instagram, tiktok, youtube, naver_blog. Length and aspect ratio follow from this.
interview.common.who.hint: An existing profile name, or say new and I will run the profile interview first.
interview.common.reference.q: Any references? Files, URLs or screenshots.
interview.common.reference.hint: Skip if there are none. References raise fidelity but also constrain the result.
interview.common.content_lang.q: Which language should the content be in?
interview.common.content_lang.hint: This is separate from the language I am talking to you in.
interview.common.count_ab.q: How many candidates, and how many hook variants?
interview.common.count_ab.hint: Candidates are complete alternatives. Hook variants only change the opening.
interview.common.budget.q: What is the cap for this run, in credits or tokens?
interview.common.budget.hint: Video formats also carry a per-item credit cap that I will not exceed.
interview.common.publish.hint: queue_only keeps it on the shelf, slot pins a UTC time, auto_after_approve publishes at the next slot once you approve.
interview.format.q: Pick a format from the catalogue, or free to write the prompt together from scratch.
interview.format.free: free: no template. I will draft the prompt with you line by line.
interview.prompt.draft: Here is the prompt draft. Change, add to or reject any part of it.
interview.prompt.confirmed: Prompt locked after {revisions} revision(s). Generating now.
queue.arm_reason_required: arm needs a reason string. Nothing is armed without one.
publish.dry_run.header: Dry run. This is the exact request payload. No network call was made.
publish.not_armed: Approved but not armed, so the tick will not publish it.
schedule.next_seven_days: Actual publishing plan for the next seven days
token.expiry_warning: {platform} token for profile {profile} expires in {days} day(s). Run factory token refresh.
error.env_missing: Missing credentials keys: {keys}. Add them to credentials.env.
error.state_handwrite: State under the runtime home is only changed through the factory CLI.
delivery.unconfirmed: A send was in flight and the answer was lost, so {item_id} is parked. Check the platform by hand: if the post is there, leave it; if not, run factory queue reopen.
delivery.reopen_refused: Not reopened: {item_id} still carries a container or a published id, so the post may exist. Check the platform first.
delivery.resume: {item_id} already has a container, so the next tick only finishes the publish step. Nothing is created twice.
queue.reopened: {item_id} is back to ready. Reason on record: {reason}
media.public_url_required: {platform} fetches media from a URL, so a local path cannot be posted. Fill media public_url first.
auth.consent.header: Open this URL in a browser and allow everything. You must be signed in as the account you are connecting; another session hands you that account's token instead.
auth.redirect.note: The redirect URL must match the registered one character for character: {redirect}
auth.paste.warning: After allowing, paste the whole address bar. Input stays hidden. The code is a single use secret, so never paste it into chat, a commit or a log.
auth.saved: {platform} connected: @{username} (profile {profile}, exchange route {route}). Keys written: {keys}. No value is ever printed.
auth.instagram.manual: The instagram exchange is not automated yet. These steps are still manual:
naver.login.header: Opening the Naver login window. Sign in yourself, including any 2FA. The session stays in {directory}. Nothing is typed for you and no cookie value is read.
naver.login.missing: No Naver session ({code}). Run factory naver login. Without it publishing stays queued as NAVER_SESSION_MISSING.
os.question: Which operating system is this? (macOS / Windows / Linux)
naver.playwright.missing: Playwright is not available ({code}). Run `npm install -g playwright` then `npx playwright install chromium`. If node cannot resolve a global install, point FACTORY_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE at the module.
wizard.input.choice: Answer with one of the values above.
wizard.input.multi: Answer with one or more values, comma separated.
wizard.input.text: Answer in one line, your own words.
wizard.input.confirm: Answer yes when done, no to leave it for later.
wizard.input.lang: Answer with one of the values, or a two letter code like ko or en.
wizard.input.slots: Answer morning, noon, evening, or custom.
wizard.input.draft: Answer as is, again, or one line of correction.
wizard.input.when: Answer now, next, or a date like 2026-10-20 21:00.
wizard.help.os: If the detected value is right, keep it.
wizard.q.ui_lang: Which language should I talk to you in?
wizard.help.ui_lang: Questions and notices come out in this language.
wizard.q.content_lang: Which language should the posts be written in?
wizard.help.content_lang: This can differ from the language we talk in.
wizard.q.brand_name: What should the account be called?
wizard.help.brand_name: The name people will see. It can change later.
wizard.q.brand_intro: In one line, what does this account do?
wizard.help.brand_intro: For example: a solo developer logging what shipping tools actually cost.
wizard.help.brand_tone: The tone writes the three persona documents for you.
wizard.choice.brand_tone.warm: Warm, like someone sitting next to you
wizard.q.platforms: Where do you want to post?
wizard.help.platforms: Only the ones you pick get connected. You can add more later.
wizard.q.connect.anthropic: I need the key for the service that writes the posts. Have you pasted it?
wizard.help.connect.anthropic: This key writes the posts. The value stays hidden and is never printed.
wizard.q.connect.higgsfield: Have you logged in to the image and video service?
wizard.help.connect.higgsfield: A browser opens and you log in. There is no key to paste.
wizard.q.connect.elevenlabs: Have you pasted the key for the video narration?
wizard.help.connect.elevenlabs: Only needed when a video has narration. Answer no to skip.
wizard.q.connect.threads: Have you connected the Threads account?
wizard.help.connect.threads: Approve it in the browser, then paste the returned address into the hidden prompt.
wizard.q.connect.instagram: Have you connected the Instagram account?
wizard.help.connect.instagram: The consent screen is automatic; saving the token follows the printed steps.
wizard.q.connect.tiktok: Have you connected the TikTok account?
wizard.help.connect.tiktok: TikTok rides on the Higgsfield login, where the account gets attached.
wizard.q.connect.youtube: Have you pasted the three YouTube upload keys?
wizard.help.connect.youtube: It needs three values from Google Cloud. Paste them one at a time.
wizard.q.connect.naver_blog: Have you signed in to Naver?
wizard.help.connect.naver_blog: A window opens and you sign in yourself. I never see the id or password.
wizard.q.slots: What time of day should posts go out?
wizard.help.slots: The time you pick is read as your local clock and stored as UTC.
wizard.q.slots_custom: Which times? Comma separate more than one.
wizard.help.slots_custom: For example 8, 20:30. Read as your local clock.
wizard.q.first_post: Shall we make the first post now?
wizard.help.first_post: Say yes and we go straight into making one.
wizard.help.what: If that is hard to answer, pick talk and just say what you want.
wizard.q.topic: In one line, what is it about?
wizard.help.topic: It does not need to be polished. One line is enough.
wizard.help.attach: Skip it if there is none. Comma separate more than one.
wizard.q.cost_ok: Shall we go ahead at that cost?
wizard.help.cost_ok: Say no and nothing gets made.
wizard.help.draft: If something should change, say what in one line and only that gets reworked.
wizard.choice.draft.fix: Say what to change in one line
wizard.help.when: Now means the next check publishes it, within fifteen minutes. Nothing goes out unapproved.
wizard.reask.default: I did not catch that. Say it once more.
wizard.reask.choice: That is not one of the choices. Pick one below.
wizard.reask.multi: I caught none of those. Pick from the names below.
wizard.reask.text: I need at least one line to move on.
wizard.reask.confirm: Answer yes if it is done, no if not yet.
wizard.reask.draft: Tell me to keep it, make another, or what to change.
wizard.reask.when: Say now, next, or a date like 2026-10-20 21:00.
wizard.reask.brand_name: That name has nothing usable in it. Mix in some letters or digits.
wizard.reask.slots_custom: I could not read that time. Write it like 8 or 20:30.
wizard.connect.keys: Key names needed: {keys}. Values are taken hidden and never printed.
wizard.draft.dry_run: (dry run) Placeholder draft, no model was called. Topic: {topic}
wizard.draft.gates_fixed: It failed a check, so it was rewritten {count} time(s). This one passed.
wizard.draft.gates_failed: It kept failing a check. What caught it: {detail}
wizard.queued.expert: Queued {item_id} for {platform}. Approving and arming are separate steps.
wizard.done.setup: Setup is finished. You can move on to making something.
wizard.done.make: This one is finished. Reset the make flow to do another.
wizard.status.header: Wizard state. Current flow {flow}, simple mode {simple}.
start.agent.ask: Which one should we talk through? ({agents})
start.agent.saved: Recorded {agent}. I will not ask again.
start.no_launch: Nothing was launched. Paste this into a terminal.
key.set.prompt: Paste the value for {name}. It will not be shown.
key.saved: Saved {name} to the {profile} profile. The value is never printed.
key.list.header: Key names on the {profile} profile. Values are not shown.
profile.template.written: Wrote {files} for the {profile} profile in the {tone} tone.
profile.platform.written: Set {platform} to {enabled} on the {profile} profile, slots {slots}.
brief.revised: Correction {revision} is now on the {brief} prompt.
wizard.draft.revised: Correction noted. Only that gets reworked.
